display_worker.scope: Diagnostic eligibility only; never gameplay acceptance or an FPS floor. completed counts successful blocking platform-submit returns, not scanout, unique visible frames, simulation progress, or peer/input experience. Timings are callback wall times including preemption. The single pending or active frame design has no drop/replacement counter or policy to infer.

semantics.cumulative: completed/failures saturate at UINT32_MAX and reset on successful init. Caller must cut epoch at an explicit worker init; a hidden init whose new counters exceed old values cannot be detected from these samples.
semantics.per_log_window: sample_frames and timing fields reset after each emission; missed emissions do not enlarge the final logged sample window.
semantics.maximum: service_max_us is a maximum within that log sample window, never a subtractable counter.
semantics.stack: stack_free_bytes is the IDF task stack high-water remaining space in bytes, not current free stack or an interval average.
semantics.first_sample: Raw window metrics remain available, but window start and screenshot cleanliness cannot be established without a preceding sample.
semantics.source_lineage: Inherited 0.66 marker contract for future 0.67 captures; this module does not establish promotion, image identity, or device execution.

display_worker.scope: Diagnostic eligibility only; never gameplay acceptance or an FPS floor. completed counts successful blocking platform-submit returns, not scanout, unique visible frames, simulation progress, or peer/input experience. Timings are callback wall times including preemption. The single pending or active frame design has no drop/replacement counter or policy to infer.

semantics.cumulative: completed/failures saturate at UINT32_MAX and reset on successful init. Caller must cut epoch at an explicit worker init; a hidden init whose new counters exceed old values cannot be detected from these samples.
semantics.per_log_window: sample_frames and timing fields reset after each emission; missed emissions do not enlarge the final logged sample window.
semantics.maximum: service_max_us is a maximum within that log sample window, never a subtractable counter.
semantics.stack: stack_free_bytes is the IDF task stack high-water remaining space in bytes, not current free stack or an interval average.
semantics.first_sample: Raw window metrics remain available, but window start and screenshot cleanliness cannot be established without a preceding sample.
semantics.source_lineage: Inherited 0.66 marker contract for future 0.67 captures; this module does not establish promotion, image identity, or device execution.
